short_horizon_movement_propagates_to_spo.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into longer-horizon EMAs
short_horizon_movement_propagates_to_spo.checkpoint: before TWAP computation and liquidation solvency check

twap_used_in_liquidation.meaning: TWAP value fed into liquidation solvency checks

borderline_account_flagged_insolvent.meaning: a borderline solvent account is flagged as insolvent by the liquidation solvency check

assumptions: The TWAP is the value consumed by the liquidation solvency check for the borderline account.
Short-horizon movement reaching spotEMA is the scenario under which the misordered blend can misclassify a borderline solvent account.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric TWAP formula binding the liquidation solvency outcome to the EMA blend weights, so the incorrect-liquidation effect is represented only by the qualitative flag borderline_account_flagged_insolvent.

limitations: Impact is stated as potential ('may flag'), not an observed incident.
No concrete account, price path, or solvency threshold is reported; symbols are symbolic.
The EMA weight formula (6/3/1 over 10) is a root cause and is not encoded as a precondition.
